reviews.text: Jess, Justin, & Chevy (sp?) made Maia’s experience at the vet SO smooth and SO joyful. We were in and out with ease! Thank you guys!

⭐⭐ Extremely Disrespectful and Unprofessional Experience

My cousin and I stopped by this animal hospital because we both have dogs and cats and were interested in getting information and possibly obtaining a business card so we could consider bringing our animals here in the future if they ever needed veterinary care.

We simply walked up to the door and were trying to figure out whether the facility was appointment-only. Instead of anyone simply coming to the door and explaining the process, a young man immediately ran toward the back of the facility and began laughing. The woman who was up front also appeared to laugh and looked at us before walking away. When the door opened and we attempted to ask a simple question, everyone seemed to scatter toward the back.

What made this interaction even more disturbing was the way we were treated compared with how the other people in the facility appeared to be treated. My cousin and I are both African-American, and based on the way we were looked at, laughed at, avoided, and treated, the entire interaction felt extremely uncomfortable and discriminatory. There was even a woman who came out of the facility who appeared visibly uncomfortable around us, despite the fact that we had done absolutely nothing to make anyone feel threatened or unsafe.

Let me be very clear: being African-American does not mean that we are broke, dangerous, looking to cause trouble, or looking to harm anyone. We were potential customers simply trying to get information about an animal hospital for our pets.

If the facility is appointment-only, there is nothing wrong with simply saying that. If there is a policy about entering the building, again, there is nothing wrong with explaining it. What is unacceptable is laughing at potential customers, running away from them, refusing to communicate, and making them feel as though they are a threat when they have done absolutely nothing wrong.

The entire experience was humiliating, disrespectful, and completely unnecessary. First impressions matter, and after what happened, I would not feel comfortable trusting this facility with my animals.

I have photographs from the visit as well. I sincerely hope management takes this complaint seriously and addresses how customers are treated at the front of the facility. No one should be made to feel unwelcome or treated like a threat simply because of the color of their skin.
Great Vet! Helped me figure out what was wrong with my 1 yr old cat and actually helped him to feel better. They take great care of our animals!!

I truly can’t say enough good things about Partners Animal Hospital. They were actually the first ones to notice that something wasn’t right with Bebe, which eventually led us to finding out about her lymphoma. Since then, they have been there for us every step of the way.

Dr. Sharpe and Dr. Megan are both wonderful. They listen to my concerns, discuss Bebe’s treatment options with me, and are always very responsive whenever I have questions or need something checked. I never feel like I’m just being rushed through an appointment.

What I appreciate most about this hospital is that you can genuinely feel that the whole team loves animals. The gentleman at the front desk is so kind and helpful. When your dog is truly part of your family, it means so much to know that the people taking care of her really care about her too.

Bebe means a lot to me, so knowing about her condition and taking her go through this journey has not been easy. Having a veterinary team that I truly trust makes such a big difference. I always feel that Bebe is genuinely cared for and in good hands here.

I’ve recommended Partners Animal Hospital to friends before, and I will continue to do so. ❤️

Li and Bebe

Amazing vets and friendly staff, we love everything about this place. Would’ve given 5 stars if they are open Saturdays. We had to run around the city for 10 hours today looking for a vet to help our sick cat. 2 different ERs, 2 different vet clinics, and $4,800+ later, he’s now taken care of. Would’ve been resolved and more time/cost-effective if they were just open on the weekends.

I’m so grateful for the extra effort, patience, and care the entire veterinary team has shown toward my Akita. He has high anxiety when visiting the vet, which can make appointments very challenging. However, the staff has gone above and beyond to make him feel as safe and comfortable as possible.

Their Fear Free approach, patience, compassion, and understanding have made such a difference. They truly take the time to work with him rather than rushing the process, while still making sure he receives the care he needs.

I really appreciate how much the staff strives to create a positive experience for him and accommodate his anxiety. It gives me so much peace of mind knowing he is in a team’s hands that genuinely cares about his well-being. Thank you for going the extra mile for my fur baby! ❤️🐾

I love Partners! The staff is so welcoming and kind. They made me feel comforted during an emotional time with my dog and didn’t rush me or pressure me into any decisions.
Justin went above and beyond, it truly meant the world to me. ❤️
I recommend Partners to anyone looking for a vet! When we are in town we won’t ever go anywhere else. Dr Sharpe and her staff especially Justin are the best!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ We appreciate the 5 stars!
Madeline Kane
Practice Manager

They saved my baby’s life! Highly recommended!! Very professional, friendly and helpful. Day1 my cat vomited  for several times. Day2 I took him to Partners Vet. After some exams, they highly suggested me to do an ultrasound at the specialty doctor. Day3 I tried to book appointment for ultrasound but couldn’t find a sooner availability since it’s already Friday. Luckily, Justin at the front desk helped me found a place in suburb. He was so supportive, patient and professional by providing several viable options with detailed information even include opening hours and instructions before ultrasound. Day4 I took my cat to this place and found that he got intestinal Intussusception, needing immediate surgery. If clinical team at Partners didn’t stress the need of ultrasound I may not be able to send my baby to surgery this soon. I did some research and found lots of cats with intestinal intussusception got diagnosed wrong at the beginning and the condition easily gets worse as time goes. Again, highly recommended!!
Justin is one of the nicest people I’ve ever met. Great reviews for the kind and patient team here and Dr. Megan. Thanks guys

Thank you for the stars, Erika!

The Team at Partners Animal Hospital South Loop

The first thing I did after moving to a new city was ask the locals which vet they trusted most. Several dog owners at Grant Park recommended this clinic — and now I understand why.

They truly stepped up for my Luka. In early April, he suddenly stopped eating, and Dr. Sharpe immediately noticed his drastic weight loss. She started him on antibiotics, tested him for lymphoma (which is unfortunately common in pits), and referred us to internal medicine at a major animal hospital. That hospital diagnosed him with a prostate infection — a diagnosis that turned out to be wrong. It was cancer, not an infection, and we lost valuable time before he could begin the treatment he actually needed.

When Luka still wasn’t improving, I asked Dr. Sharpe’s team to run a BRAF test, and they got it done the same day. They followed up with the lab constantly, pushing for updates so I could get results sooner than expected.

Then my insurance refused to pay. Again, Dr. Sharpe’s team spent hours on the phone advocating for Luka, helping move his case forward so he could get the care he needed. When we finally received the devastating news, Dr. Sharpe reached out on her day off to recommend top-tier oncologists. She even coordinated directly with the MedVet oncologist to make sure Luka could get the emergency medication he needed right away.

This is above-and-beyond care. I’m so grateful she treats my pets as if they were her own.

We were close to our vet back in Dallas, and finding Partners — a place that treats us like family — has been such a relief. Shoutout to Justin and Emi, too. They are incredibly kind.

Hi Jenni,
Thank you for the fantastic review! We look forward to seeing you and your feline family member again!
-James, Practice Manager

Dr Sharp and the entire staff are knowledgeable, professional and caring-every time! My cat doesn’t even come home upset.. he’s totally cool!!
This is June 2026: Just Go There !!!

This is an update 3Mos Later:  I can’t believe this was only my 2nd Visit to Partners-the people there make you feel like Family! This time I saw Dr Stricker-assisted by Selena-both of whom were knowledgeable, caring and attentive to what was needed for my Cat, SweetieRing!
The entire staff, atmosphere and care is thorough
including helpful information about Sweetie’s overall situation. & People  at the front desk- James & others -go out of their way to be helpful.
GO TO THIS VET!!

I was referred to Partners and after my experience have thanked the person who did that profusely! The Exam was thorough, professional and caring & the Nurse and Dr. Sharp were great! I’m looking forward to future care for my cat (family member) at Partners.

Thank you for the stars, Laura!
Wendy and the Team at Partners Animal Hospital South Loop

Every visit to Partners South Loop is a 10-out-of-10 experience. From the moment we walk through the door until checkout, Winston and I are treated with exceptional care. The staff greets him by name, knows his history and why he's there, and always handles him with gentleness and compassion. What stands out most is how personal the experience feels. The receptionists, techs, nurses, and doctors work seamlessly together, and it's clear they genuinely know and care about their patients. I can't say enough positive things about the team at Partners; I recommend them without hesitation.

Thank you for the stars, Matt!
Wendy and Team at Partners Animal Hospital South Loop

Hi Varun,
Thank you for the 5-star review! We look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon!

First time using this office for my dog that requires special care--she is very afraid of Vet offices with a history of non-successful Vet visits. What typically is an all-day process requiring a drop-off and heavy sedation, I was able to get the exam, blood draw and vaccines completed in under an hour. This is an extremely warm, collaborative, and professional team. They handled my dog with care, but with the technique and skill needed to get an efficient outcome. I am beside myself at how much less stressful this Vet visit was compared to any she has had in the past. I also took note of how they maintained space/barriers between animals in the building to help all pets remain less anxious. I look forward to knowing this team is behind me and my dogs and am so much less stressed over coming back for any future visits. Highly recommend!
